hypotheses.evidence_gap: No paper in the library tests kallexjorib against fasting glucose directly. The weakest link is "kallexjorib decreases serum traphenjorase": 91 papers, of which 11 report the opposite direction and 20 no effect.
hypotheses.suggested_design: Two-arm randomised trial of kallexjorib against control. Primary endpoint: change in fasting glucose. Measure serum traphenjorase at baseline and follow-up to test whether it carries the effect. About 175 participants per arm detects a standardised difference of 0.3 with 80% power. The hypothesis fails if fasting glucose does not move in the predicted direction (up).
hypotheses.status: untested: a hypothesis, not a finding
